name: Intention.ai
tagline: A browser extension that reads whether you look tired, focused or stressed and suggests how to structure study time.

awards: Best Beginner Hack (>2 members first time)

problem: Students lose many hours to disruptions and lack of focus.
solution: A computer-vision model classifies focus states from the webcam during study, tracks patterns and gives personalised recommendations.
demo_moment: Team-described: study for a while and receive a suggestion based on your focus pattern.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Beginner Hack (>2 members first time)” among 85 submissions.
A beginner team picked a problem they live with.

lessons: For a beginner prize, a working end-to-end loop beats an ambitious half-build.
